description: OWL 1 era RDF files counted for OWL035 (issue #196). Nothing is vendored: each repository is checked out at its commit by `scripts/owl_restriction_count.py fetch`, which refuses any other commit. Only the listed directories are checked out. The files are the test data of three OWL tools; the page says what that does and does not show.

repositories.domain: Apache Jena core test data (W3C OWL 1 test cases, wine, food and other ontologies)
Pellet reasoner test data (OWL 1 test suites, SWRL, Liebig tests)
